properties.description:
Fourth, I want tools adapted to reviewing changes made by agents so :
- I still have control and understanding of what is produced.
- Review is not the bottleneck for what is produced, without solving the challenge by reducing review quality.
- I can give the feedback in the context where it make sense (annotate ui, document, code, ...) and not have to give the context by myself before the feedback.
properties.title: Contextual, efficient review
